description: Deterministic visual comparison harness and observed baseline. Cases are generated from this profile so later tasks register additional profiles without editing verify.py.

knownDefects.description: Bright windshield/side glass with dotted white speckles on the upper edge and wiper line; authored coverage alpha and transmission are not separated.
knownDefects.label: known-defect

knownDefects.description: Roof/window interpenetration reads as a flat white plate without layered glass depth; mesh-centre sorting cannot order these transparent surfaces.
knownDefects.label: known-defect

knownDefects.description: A verified complete model can present background-only frames for several seconds while texture counters already look stable. T20 refuses blank frames; T23 owns the complete-load readiness contract.
knownDefects.label: known-defect

knownDefects.description: The T19 terminal ResourceLimit after visible geometry did not reproduce in the T20 run. The label remains; a passing local load is not proof of a fix.
knownDefects.label: known-defect

knownDefects.description: The generated Khronos-style tinted, rough and clear transmission spheres render nearly identically as clear glass; transmission/volume/ior roles are not differentiated.
knownDefects.label: known-defect

knownDefects.description: The installed F3D 3.5.0 preset renders the Camera lens as a flat pale/gray disk; it is a reference observation, not an accepted glass target.
knownDefects.label: known-defect

knownDefects.description: The shipped F3D preset is DPI-aware (1920x1350 for a 1280x900 request); the controlled no-config render is 1280x900. They are different reference conditions.
knownDefects.label: limitation

knownDefects.description: GPU/driver/OS differences are expected. Global tolerances supplement local region checks; they are not a cross-renderer quality score.
knownDefects.label: limitation
